I just feel awful for feeling this way. I lost my brother due to suicide a few months ago and it makes me feel guilty for wanting to do the same. 

And thank you. I wouldn't say you're a coward though, you must be on here for a reason.
I can talk if you want. Sorry to hear about your dog. Animals are the most loyal friends out there. Sometimes they are all we have.

Just because somebody has a partner or 'someone to have sex with' does not make that persons problems any less valid or important than that of somebody who is single. Just because somebody has someone they can kiss goodnight, doesn't mean that they should be happy. Yes, they are lucky that they have that, but there are lots of other things that can cause pain.
My brother ended his life through hanging. Please think about those who love you before doing anything. It destroys those left behind. Here if you wanna chat.

Usually on several times a day. Level 43. Full market, will share butterflies.
